Get multiple objects by their IDs.



You can provide IDs either:

- Via --ids flag (comma-separated): --ids BLI-001,BLI-002,BLI-003

- Via --file flag (YAML array of IDs): --file ids.yaml



Full objects are loaded and overlays applied per object; optional --fields keeps
only those

top-level keys in each successful result (same hybrid projection as object get /
list).

  Get multiple objects by ID
  zqk object bulk get --ids BLI-001,BLI-002,BLI-003
  Get from file
  zqk object bulk get --file ids.yaml
  Output as JSON
  zqk object bulk get --ids BLI-001,BLI-002 --format json
  JSON with selected keys only
  zqk object bulk get --ids PROMPT-001,PROMPT-002 --fields id,kind,prompt_body --format json

Usage:
  zqk object bulk get [flags]

Flags:
      --columns string          Override column widths for table output (format: field:width)
      --fields stringArray      Top-level keys per successful object in output (repeat or comma-separated); same hybrid projection as object get.
      --file string             Path to YAML file containing array of IDs
  -f, --format string           Output format (table, json, jsonl, yaml, csv, json-rpc, stream, agent-prompt, semantic-link, raw, md, html) (default "table")
      --ids string              Comma-separated list of object IDs
      --ignore-scheduler-down   Ignore scheduler down warning/lockdown
      --link-hydration string   Reference overlay per object: none, lazy, default, or eager (same semantics as object get; default is none/raw).
  -o, --output string           Write output to file
  -q, --quiet                   Suppress non-essential output
      --timeout duration        Timeout for command execution (0 = auto-calculate)
  -v, --verbose                 Verbose output
      --view string             Optional view name to scope output fields per object.

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
      --internal         Elevated access mode for built-in and internal kinds (requires Enterprise license or zqk-admin)
